This role reports to the VP of Engineering, sits on the engineering leadership team, and works across Product, Software, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and more. What You'll Own
 
 
New Product Development

Systems Engineering & Compliance

Team Leadership & Process
 
 

* Lead and grow a team of NPD, Systems, and Co

: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow.
